negative_result: Anatomical MRI volumetry alone cannot determine active muscle volume V_active. sEMG RMS = 12.7% does not measure recruited fiber fraction; without solving the ill-posed neuromuscular inverse problem, V_active remains an unobserved latent scenario variable.
impact: Rejects assumption that V_active equals V_anat from 3D MRI.

negative_result: Absolute phosphagen energy scale cannot be identified from 31P-MRS peak ratios alone without external phantom calibration or assumed [ATP]_ref, inducing an 8.50-fold span in resting chemical buffer capacity (111.4 to 947.0 J).
impact: Prevents overconfident claims of exact chemical pool quantification.

negative_result: Non-invasive continuous-wave NIRS vascular occlusion testing and arterial spin labeling (ASL) MRI cannot independently isolate M_loc without unknown optical pathlength and venous extraction calibration; catheterization data from quadriceps cannot be treated as measured calf baseline.
impact: Disqualifies uncalibrated optical and perfusion surrogates as absolute metabolic anchors.

negative_result: Direct transfer of local single-muscle constants to the macroscopic D2 model is physically impermissible; TARGET-CPE45 cannot be validated from local calf imaging data alone.
impact: Maintains TARGET-CPE45 as NOT EXTERNALLY VALIDATED and enforces NO_GO on biological interventions.

hypothesis: Surface EMG RMS amplitude monotonically tracks active muscle volume fraction a_eff during dynamic contractions.
result: Refuted: SAT thickness variation (3 to 10 mm) creates a 40.9-fold uncertainty ridge, and fatigue causes an inverse dissociation (+14% RMS at -35% force).
impact: Eliminates scalar sEMG amplitude as a direct physiological anchor for active tissue volume.

hypothesis: Local muscle bioenergetic parameters can achieve empirical practical identifiability using existing disconnected literature datasets.
result: Refuted: When nuisance parameters (a_eff, h_fat, g_nirs, b_nirs, k_spec) are unfrozen, the system suffers a rank defect of 7, with flat profile likelihood ridges.
impact: Establishes that practical identifiability strictly requires simultaneous multi-modal recordings on the same subject.

hypothesis: Local oxidative recovery time constants (tau_PCr) are universal across human skeletal muscle groups and can be directly transferred between calf and thigh.
result: Refuted: Cross-muscle transfer between gastrocnemius (tau = 24.3 s) and quadriceps (tau = 39.2 s) degrades predictive RMSE by up to +189.3%.
impact: Blocks uncalibrated cross-muscle kinetic transfer and confirms the necessity of muscle-specific scaling.
